definitions.explanation: The initial teaching or introduction to a skill, art, or discipline. Implies personal, hands-on guidance from someone experienced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}ほどき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received my first lessons in shogi from my father.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}ほどき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I was given an introduction to the tea ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}ほどき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながった。
examples.english: The cooking lessons I received from my grandmother led to my current career.

notes:
USAGE:
Implies personal, one-on-one guidance rather than classroom instruction. Often used for traditional arts and skills. The most common patterns are {手|て}ほどき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive instruction) and {手|て}ほどき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give instruction).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手|て}ほどき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive initial instruction)
- {手|て}ほどき⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give initial instruction)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手|て}ほどき (introduction to ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{入門|にゅうもん}→入門：11643_nyuumon⟧: introduction to a field (more formal, can be self-study)
- ⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧: guidance, coaching (broader, ongoing instruction)
